title: WorkerEvent
description: The canonical event envelope for every event emitted in the AI Marketing Intelligence OS. All 49 event types use this envelope. The payload field is typed per event_type using the per-event schemas in this directory.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event instance. Generated by the worker at time of emission. Never reused.

event_type.description: Closed enum of all valid event types. Determines the shape of the payload field.

schema_version.description: Contract version e.g. '1.0'. Allows consumers to reject or migrate events from unknown versions.

organization_id.description: Tenant isolation. Every event is scoped to exactly one organization. The event journal enforces this.

mission_id.description: The mission this worker is executing. Optional — some workers (e.g. heartbeat) may not be tied to a mission.

task_id.description: The specific task that triggered this event. Links the event to a WorkerTask DB row.

parent_task_id.description: If this task was created by another task (delegation), the originating task ID. Used to build causation chains.

worker_id.description: The worker entity that emitted this event. Links to the workers DB table.

worker_run_id.description: The current execution run of this worker. A worker may have many runs. Sequence numbers are scoped to the run.

correlation_id.description: Groups all events in one logical operation (e.g. one investigation = one correlation_id). Enables full-investigation log queries.

causation_id.description: The event_id of the event that caused this event. For example, a worker.evidence_found event is caused by a worker.page_fetched event. Enables causation chain visualization.

trace_id.description: OpenTelemetry W3C trace context trace ID. Enables distributed tracing across all services.

span_id.description: OpenTelemetry W3C trace context span ID.

source_connection_id.description: Which source connection is being used. Links to source_connections DB table.

entity_id.description: The world model entity being processed, if known. Links to entities DB table.

product_id.description: The product context, if known at time of event. Links to products DB table.

logical_zone.description: The logical zone this worker is operating in. Used by the frontend ZoneRegistry to determine 3D position. NEVER contains world coordinates.

logical_station.description: The specific station within the logical zone. Used by ZoneRegistry for precise 3D positioning within a zone.

dedupe_key.description: SHA-256 of (worker_id + operation_type + target_url_or_id). Prevents storing duplicate work if the same URL is fetched twice in the same run. Unique constraint in event_journal.

idempotency_key.description: SHA-256 of (task_id + attempt_number + event_type). Prevents double-execution of the same action on replay. Unique constraint in event_journal.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing integer scoped to worker_run_id. Consumers use this to detect out-of-order or stale events. Events with sequence < last_seen_sequence are dropped.

occurred_at.description: When the event occurred according to the worker clock. ISO 8601 with timezone.

processed_at.description: When the event was written to the journal (server clock). Set by EventPublisher. Not present in the raw event before journaling.

payload.description: Event-type-specific data. The shape is defined per event_type in the contracts/events/ per-event schemas. Consumers must validate payload against the correct per-event schema.

metadata.description: Arbitrary string key-value pairs for extensibility. Use sparingly — prefer typed payload fields for anything business-critical.
